target.title: Adopt macOS Golden Gate edge-to-edge settings sidebar
target.body:
## Summary

Adopts the macOS 27 Golden Gate simplified sidebar design in the Settings window. The Tahoe-style floating sidebar card (rounded corners, inset padding, double drop shadow, rim strokes, blurred wash) is replaced with an edge-to-edge sidebar: plain sidebar material running to the window edges and up behind the titlebar, separated from the detail pane by a hairline divider — matching how Golden Gate reverts sidebars to the pre-Tahoe look.

- `PreferencesView`: remove all card chrome (clip shape, shadows, strokes, wash color, extra blur, edge insets); the sidebar now fills its column with the `NSVisualEffectView` sidebar material and ignores the safe area so it reaches the top of the window
- Settings window style: insert `.fullSizeContentView` (previously explicitly removed) so the sidebar material extends behind the transparent titlebar; content stays below it via the safe area
- New regression test: window keeps `.fullSizeContentView` and a transparent titlebar
- Changelog entry under 0.41.1 Unreleased

## Before / After

| Before (Tahoe floating card) | After (Golden Gate edge-to-edge) |
| --- | --- |
| ![Settings sidebar before: floating rounded card with shadow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/CodexBar/87f4b886c5923df1fc5d9842d6886f7a000e2351/docs/screenshots/settings-sidebar-card-before.png) | ![Settings sidebar after: edge-to-edge sidebar with hairline separator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/CodexBar/87f4b886c5923df1fc5d9842d6886f7a000e2351/docs/screenshots/settings-sidebar-goldengate-after.png) |

Both screenshots are from live builds of this branch (before = parent commit), captured via window-ID screencapture.

## Testing

- `swift test --filter SettingsWindowAppearanceTests` — 9 tests passed, including the new edge-to-edge regression test
- `make check` — SwiftFormat/SwiftLint clean, 0 violations
- Built and relaunched the app via `Scripts/compile_and_run.sh`; screenshots above are from the running app
